create.name: Constantina M. Vaseliades
create.bio:
Constantina M. Vaseliades is a Quantum-Touch instructor and practitioner based in St. Petersburg, Florida, where she runs Lifeforce, a practice whose full name, Harmonious Healing for People and Pets, reflects her work with animals as well as people. A former professional ballet dancer, she turned to the healing arts in 1980 and founded Lifeforce in 2001, by which time she was an ordained minister and taught Usui Reiki at master level. Over the years she added Tong Ren, Quantum-Touch, animal communication and Supreme Science Qigong, which she now teaches to Level 3.

She brings these methods together in what she calls Advanced Energy Healing Therapy: sessions that draw on Reiki, Quantum-Touch, chakra colour work and qigong, chosen intuitively for each visit. Sessions take place in person in St. Petersburg or at a distance, by phone or in silence, for people and for animals. As a teacher she leads the weekend Quantum-Touch Level 1 workshop, the Reiki levels up to master teacher, chakra and crystal workshops, animal communication courses and qigong classes, for groups or as private tutoring. Her outlook rests on the idea that all beings are one, and she encourages a simple, grounded daily rhythm of breath, gentle movement and meditation.

courses.title: Advanced Energy Healing sessions
courses.description: One-to-one energy sessions in St. Petersburg, or at a distance by phone or in silence, for people and for animals. Constantina blends Reiki, Quantum-Touch, chakra colour work and qigong as she senses each session needs.
courses.price: $115.00 (1 hour 30 minutes, in person); $80.00 (1 hour, long distance)

courses.title: Quantum-Touch Level I workshop
courses.description: A weekend workshop of around twelve hours on the Quantum-Touch breathing and awareness techniques, with resonance, visualisation and distance work. Everyone who attends receives a certificate that counts towards practitioner certification.

courses.title: Animal Communication workshop
courses.description: A workshop on tuning in intuitively to companion animals and sensing their thoughts and feelings, taught as a six- or twelve-hour course. Constantina also offers animal communication in her sessions.

courses.title: Qigong instruction
courses.description: Personal or group qigong classes in the Supreme Science Qigong style, built on simple breathing, standing practice and slow wuji movement. Personal instruction runs through Levels 1 to 3.
